answers.answer: Bharatiya Kisan Union (Ekta Ugrahan) organizes farmer protests and mobilizes farmers through block-level meetings and village outreach to demand policy changes and compensation.
Viability stems from being farmer-led (affected-led), which sustains activism through mobilization of farmers.

They need scrapping of proposed India-US trade agreement, repeal of four labour codes, withdrawal of Electricity Amendment Bill and Seed Bill, immediate release of compensation for paddy crops damaged by dwarf virus, scrapping of land pooling policy, grant of proprietary rights to tenant cultivators, financial relief for suicide-victim farm families, statutory guarantee for MSP, fair distribution of river waters, elimination of corporate control over water resources, assured canal water supply to every field, provision of clean drinking water to all households, and unconditional dismissal of all criminal cases and stubble-burning FIRs registered against farmers.
